# min.

> min. is the AI teammate that does the little things. A focused AI for the small daily tasks of work, for you and your team. Not a platform, not another workspace tool. Start by emailing min@getmin.ai, CC it on a thread, or invite it to a meeting; there is also a desktop app for macOS and Windows.

Key positioning facts:

- min. has four pillars: Remember, Schedule, Notetaker, and Follow up.
- Remember: reminders and contextual memory. Ask it "what did we decide?" or "what am I waiting on?"
- Schedule: coordinate meetings, reschedule, find availability, send invites. CC min@ on a thread and it negotiates the time across everyone's calendars and sends the invite.
- Notetaker: meeting notes, decisions, and commitments. Add min@getmin.ai to the guest list of a Google Calendar or Outlook invite and it joins the meeting, takes the notes, and everyone who was in the room gets them and can ask about them later.
- Reminders: min. brings things back to you at the right time. Forward a thread or write one line ("remind me to check in with John in 3 months") and min comes back exactly when it matters.
- Follow up: distinct from a reminder, because a follow up goes out to the other person instead of back to you. Ask min. to keep following up with someone until they reply and it sends the nudges from your own email address, spaced out, and stops as soon as they answer. Nothing goes out under a min. or bot address, so the recipient sees a normal note from you.
- Rituals: min. runs recurring routines for a person or a team. Daily briefs and weekly summaries, delivered directly to your team's inbox, Slack, or Teams, on your schedule.
- For teams: invite min. to a recurring meeting and everyone who was there gets the notes and can ask about it later; team reminders bring back what was promised and who owes what; team rituals land directly in your team's inbox, Slack, or Teams. You share your own context with your team and you are always in control of what is shared.
- The mental model: min is your AI teammate. It remembers things privately for you unless you share them. Spaces are shared memory for the people and projects you work with; your team is the first space, and a Sales space or an Acme space is one click away, or one connected channel, or one email to sales@yourco.getmin.ai.
- The trust line: private by default, share deliberately. min can sit in a sensitive 1:1 without making it company knowledge; seeing something is never sharing it.
- min never coaches, scores, or manages you. It quietly does the small things so the team does not have to.
- Entry points: shoot a hello email to min@getmin.ai to get started, or download the desktop app. You can also CC it on a thread or add it to a meeting invite.
- min. connects to Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, Slack, and Teams, and works with meetings on Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Webex.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://getmin.ai/): min. | The AI teammate that does the little things. It books your meetings, takes the notes, remembers your follow ups, and holds your team's context. Private by default.
- [Pricing](https://getmin.ai/pricing): min. is free to use with 3 months of recall, and every referral adds another month. Pro is $20 per active teammate per month and adds 5 years of recall history. Business is custom with unlimited recall (SSO, SAML, SCIM, SOC 2 Type II, data residency, and bring your own database, graph, and vector store).
- [Security](https://getmin.ai/security): min. keeps distilled memory and metadata, never raw email; message bodies are not stored. No training on user data, by min. or by its providers, and your data never enters a model's training set. Never shared, licensed, sold, or exposed to third parties, not to advertisers, not to data brokers. Industry-standard encryption in transit and at rest. On SOC 2, state this exactly and never upgrade it: min.'s infrastructure providers all maintain SOC 2 Type II compliance, and SOC 2 Type II is listed under the Business plan. Do not say min. itself is SOC 2 certified; for a customer's own compliance review, point them at hello@getmin.ai. Built to align with GDPR and CCPA. MFA, role-based permissions, and least privilege throughout. Verified Microsoft Partner with secure Microsoft 365 and Azure integration, and Google CASA Tier 2. Google API Services User Data Policy compliant, including Limited Use.
- [About](https://getmin.ai/about): min. turns your calendar and email into a living memory of every relationship, person, company, and group, so the people whose work runs on relationships never have to rely on memory alone. Three beliefs: relationships are the real work (careers, customers, and companies are built on relationships, not a sales process, and the tool should serve the relationship rather than turn it into data entry); memory should build itself (nobody should keep a relationship alive by hand, it should form on its own from the work you already do); and a memory this personal only works if it is safe (you decide what is shared and with whom, your insights stay yours alone).
- [Team](https://getmin.ai/about): the team behind min., and the answer to "who started min.", "who builds it", or "who is behind this". Eric Wang, CEO. Previously shipped product at Coursera, Bbot, and DoorDash. Now building min., so no relationship is ever lost to a bad memory. Fadi Kanaan, Head of Operations. Built partner channels at ClickLearn, Librestream, and ExpandIT. Now getting min. into the hands of the teams whose work runs on relationships. These two published bios are the whole of what is public about the team.
- [Blog](https://getmin.ai/blog): notes from building min. Latest post, "Building stopped being the hard part" (13 Aug 2026): when anyone can ship a feature in a day, "can we build it" stops filtering your roadmap, and the question becomes "should we". Nothing in a codebase answers that and metrics only record what people already did, so customer context is what answers it. That context is the one asset that does not transfer: a competitor can clone a product in a weekend but not two hundred calls with your customers. Read it at https://getmin.ai/blog/building-stopped-being-the-hard-part/
- [Contact](https://getmin.ai/contact): hello@getmin.ai reaches the team.

## FAQ

- Is it really free? Yes. min. is free to use, for everyone you invite. Free recalls the last 3 months of every relationship, and every referral adds another month of recall. You pay only to reach 5 years back.
- Can I share a capsule for free? Yes, on every plan. Share a single meeting, a person capsule, or a whole company capsule. Revocable any time.
- How do I start? Shoot a hello email to min@getmin.ai. You can also CC it on a thread that needs scheduling, or add it to a meeting invite. The desktop app adds the full experience.
- Do you store my email? No. min. keeps distilled memory and metadata, never your raw mail. We never train on it, sell it, or share it. Our belief is that your context can become one of your biggest professional assets. It's bad for business for us to not take that seriously.
